ops.text: InstallFresh holds the existing deployment lock once; pre-recovery and pre-activation gates refuse with ErrNotFresh; never calls recover/Quiesce/drain/Terminate/terminateSurvivors/converge/launchd.Apply/Remove; zero bootout on every path
Fresh is read-only (no mkdir, no lock, no write) and refuses an installed canonical app before any Control attach or inventory
Default public verbs and sentinels behave byte-identically
Regressions R1-R11 and L1-L3 present; R8 injects a pending Prior swap under the real deployment lock
CI green on exact SHA, 2 independent Sol PASS, v0.34.0 released
